# Private regression fixtures

The public repository intentionally does not distribute recorded-paper fixtures.
The maintainer suite contains extracted evidence, numerical records and source
metadata from third-party publications that are not covered by the repository's
MIT license.

Tests that require those files remain visible and are explicitly skipped when the
private fixture directory is absent. The public suite therefore reports 180 tests
discovered, 158 executed and 22 skipped.

Contributors should reproduce new defects with the smallest synthetic fixture
possible. Do not submit journal PDFs, long quotations, local absolute paths,
author email addresses, manually digitized datasets, or `.internal` extraction
packages unless redistribution rights are documented.
